answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond at a jetty registry, released after three atlas milestones signed by its own key. A vine graph bars one milestone from serving two identities; an atlas panel audits signatures, and reuse burns the bond. One fake costs 45 credits. The k-th fake in one cluster adds 3(k-1) credits, as the panel re-checks the cluster, so the 1,000th costs 3,042 and 1,000 fakes cost 1,543,500. A rented-milestone ring fails: milestones signed by another key are flagged by the vine graph and bonds burn. One honest agent pays 45 once and keeps full weight.
